then.u_message: "A Sporemon! Hope you're not planning on growing mushrooms indoors." They chuckle.
"Hey, a Kreckmon! Little firecracker, aren't they?" They grin.
"A Skelemon! Spooky. I like it." They nod approvingly.
"Zappermon! Watch where you point that thing." They laugh.
"Is that a Fleshcocoonmon?" They lean back. "That's... something."
"A Sproutmon! Aw, little guy's just a baby." They smile.
"A Cockroachmon, huh?" They wrinkle their nose. "Tough break."
"Brainlessmon... yeah, I can see it." They smirk.
"HOLY... is that a MEGA?!" They stare at your Zombivice with wide eyes.
"Hey, a fully evolved Zombimon! Looking strong." They nod appreciatively.
"A Zombimon! Growing up quick, huh?" They glance at your Zombivice.

else.u_message: "A baby Zombimon!" They grin. "Cherish this stage."
